cross_verification.note_en: Solomon Islands Immigration Division confirms visa applications require a passport biopage copy and related documents, but no official page (main site, visitor-visa/tourist page, know-your-visa-requirements page, or division-resources page) states specific photo dimensions, background color, or composition rules. The Division's own site notes that online-payment/e-visa functionality was still undergoing technical testing at the time of research, with in-person applications remaining the primary route. No numeric specification could be confirmed from an official source.
